main.description: Hybrid talent search over public profiles: pgvector cosine similarity and Postgres full-text search, fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k = 60). Served by the AppView. Query terms that refer to a protected attribute (age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, …) are dropped and reported in ignoredTerms.

q.description: What you are looking for, in words.

openToWork.description: Only actors whose profile says they are open to work (true), or not (false).

location.description: Case-insensitive substring of the profile's location.

skills.description: Every one must be on the profile's skills list (case-insensitive).

mode.description: Retrievers to use. vector and fts exist for evaluation and debugging.

ignoredTerms.description: Query terms dropped because they refer to a protected attribute.

degraded.description: True when the vector retriever was unavailable, so results come from full-text search alone.

score.description: Fused score in millionths (lexicons have no floats). Comparable only within one response.

matchedBy.description: Which retrievers returned this actor, for debugging.
